tost_delta_note: tost_min_margins is, per replication, the smallest delta at which both interaction CIs fall inside +-delta; the TOST power at any delta is the share <= delta (tost_power). delta is NOT chosen here (ADR-114 decision 5). tost_min_margins hold successful fits only; the tost_n_failed failed fits enter tost_power and the margin quantiles on the unfavourable side (power sheets: equivalent, delta 0; error sheets: not equivalent, delta +inf, a quantile reaching them is null). ADR-125
assumed_values_note: n_item, sigma and rho are ASSUMED values, not measurements; n_item here is NOT eval.cells (05_STATISTICS.md section 6.8; ADR-122 / ADR-123)
gates: none (PLAN-044 Q3 (a)): failure rates and CP intervals are recorded, nothing closes
ceiling_note: ceiling levels L are ASSUMED values fixed by a rule before fitting (ceiling_level.py); everything here is descriptive and is NOT a statement about the real experiment (PLAN-044 trap 5)
